pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 O-O
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4-g5 with the bishop on g5; plan 4 read control of e5 as a move. Rewrote plans 1 and 4 (Bh6 trade, ...h6); British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Saemisch, 8.Bg5 O-O 9.Qd2 a6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4-h4-g5 with the bishop on g5; plan 4 played ...Na6-c7 with a pawn on a6. Rewrote plans 1 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Mikenas Attack, 8...Nfd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted Ne2-g3 (ambiguous, not the line's idea); rewritten around Nb5 and e6. British spelling (Defence, centre).

pages.name: Benoni: Mikenas Attack, 8...Nfd7 9.e6
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an open d-file that does not exist; plan 2 relied on a Black passed e-pawn that cannot arise after 9...fxe6 10.dxe6. Rewrote both plans; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Mikenas Attack, 8...Nfd7 9.Nb5
pages.notes: Plan 1 played Ne4 with no knight able to reach it; plan 2 pushed ...b5 onto White's knight; plan 3 claimed an unconfirmed d5 sacrifice. Rewrote plans 1-3 around 9...dxe5 10.Nd6+ Ke7 11.Nxc8+; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni Defense: Taimanov Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 pushed ...b5 with the bishop on b5; plan 4 rerouted ...Na6-c7 while Black is in check. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 8...Nbd7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nf3-g5 and h4-h5 with no knight on f3; plan 2 pushed ...b5 onto the bishop and promised a passed a-pawn. Rewrote plans 1-3 around 9.e5 and the pin on d7; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 8...Nfd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Na6 after ...a6. Rewrote plan 2 around ...Qh4+; plan 1 wording and British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 (Zaitsev)
pages.notes: Plan 1 relied on a g4-g5 storm; plan 3 pushed ...b5 with the bishop on b5. Rewrote plans 1 and 3 around 9...Qh4+ 10.g3 Qe7; British spelling.

pages.name: Benoni: Four Pawns, Taimanov, 9.a4 a6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...Na6 with a pawn on a6; plan 4 sent the d7-knight to c6. Rewrote plans 1, 2 and 4 (a knight on e5 was also rejected: fxe5); British spelling.
